text:
Tom: Heads up — our APAC AWS Marketplace listing just went live in preview. Partner told us 8–12 resellers will onboard over the next 6–8 weeks and expect a combined baseline of ~1.2M tokens/day to start. Can infra give a quick capacity ask?

Maya: Nice! :tada: important to size this right before public launch. resellers will expect low latency in ap-northeast-1.

Diego: Quick note: APAC capacity is already tight in ap-northeast-1; our current spare A100 pool there is 12 GPUs. If we want dedicated capacity for marketplace partners we should either reserve more or route to nearby regions (ap-southeast-1/ap-south-1) with traffic steering.

Riya: For clarity can we get expected concurrency and session length from sales? Tom, what does "1.2M tokens/day" map to in requests?

Tom: Rough split from partner: ~6 resellers will do small pilot traffic first week: 200–300 sessions/day each, avg 400 tokens/session. After pilot they scale to 1k sessions/day each. So conservative Q3 ramp: 2.5k sessions/day -> peak concurrency ~40–60.

Diego: Back-of-envelope calc: assume 400 tokens/session, 0.5s to generate on A100 per session (including overhead) => ~0.00014 GPU-hours/session. So 2.5k sessions/day ≈ 0.35 GPU-hours/day. But peaks matter: if traffic bursts into 1hr window with concurrency 60 we need capacity for 60 concurrent workers.

Riya: That per-session GPU-hours number feels low — pulling in profiling numbers now.

OpsBot: [deploy status] ap-northeast-1 spare pool = 12x A100, queued requests for capacity increase: ticket #INC-4821.

Diego: Important caveat: those per-session timings depend heavily on model variant. If marketplace uses the full-precision 70B we should expect 4–6x the latency and memory footprint vs a 7B quantized variant. Recommend we offer two SKU options to resellers: "standard" (quantized 13B) and "premium" (70B) with routing rules.

Maya: Good call. Partners will accept a cheaper quantized SKU for cost-sensitive customers. Sales: can you pressure test preferred SKUs?

Tom: I'll confirm next hour. They want a single easy plan to buy (marketplace listing) but can accept tiering.

Anya: Financial ask: if we reserve dedicated capacity we'll need a 3–6 month commit. What's the suggested reserve?

Diego: If we want to avoid cross‑region routing and provide <100ms p95 gen latency in ap-northeast-1 for quantized 13B, I'd reserve a warm pool of ~24x A100 equivalents (can be a mix of A10/80GB etc). That gives headroom for pilot + initial scale and room for burst/overprovisioning.

Riya: From forecast viewpoint, propose two scenarios for the spreadsheet:
- conservative: 12 GPUs reserved, rely on routing to other regions for spikes; pilot + minimal SLA
- optimistic: 24 GPUs reserved to guarantee APAC latency and handle 2x pilot scale.

Diego: Also call out networking limits: AWS Marketplace traffic will have seller-to-buyer egress and NAT gateway bandwidth constraints in customers' VPCs if using Private offer. We saw one customer saturate 10Gb NAT in staging last month. Recommend we add egress/bandwidth checks for each reseller onboarding.

Maya: Ops checklist for partners: region, expected sku, monthly committed spend, preferred latency SLO, contact for infra validation. I'll make a template.

Tom: Action items: I'll collect exact sessions/day + SKU preference (due EOD).

Riya: I'll build the demand forecast sheet and include GPU-hours, reserved GPU ask, cost delta for quantized vs full FP, and sensitivity to 2x and 5x demand spikes. Target EOD Fri.

Diego: I'll open capacity ticket with cloud ops to request quota bump in ap-northeast-1 and ask for temporary burst capacity in ap-southeast-1 as fallback. Ticket will include pool size scenarios.

Anya: I'll model cost vs committed discount: 24 GPUs reserved vs on-demand for 3 months. Also include marketplace take rate and reseller margin assumptions.

Maya: One more risk: marketplace billing delay -> revenue recognition lag could mean we need to pre-fund capacity until payouts come through. Finance, flag if that's a problem.

Anya: Good point — we'll need cashflow buffer if we pre-reserve GPUs. I'll include a short cashflow note in the spreadsheet.

Tom: Thanks team. If we can turn the forecast into a single commit request by next Monday I can lock marketplace listing terms with partner.

Diego: Will post ticket number and initial infra timeline once created.

Maya: I'll drop the partner onboarding template in this thread when ready. :white_check_mark:

Tom: Great — pinging @here for visibility.

(20:14) OpsBot: ticket INC-4839 created by Diego: capacity increase request ap-northeast-1 (24 GPU warm pool).
